sheet.name: Young Devour Dragon
sheet.footprint: 3x3; rear = the three cells behind (R R R)

traits.name: Falling Skies
traits.text:
Additional Setup: Take the three Phase Trait cards, Flying High (Phase I), Floating Low (Phase II), and Grounded (Phase III), and place them in a stack face up (Flying High on top, Grounded on the bottom). Only the effects of the top card are active.
! When a Knight deals a Wound, do not Escalate!
Exhibition Clash: Remove the Grounded (Phase III) Phase Trait card.

traits.name: Ruined Bastion
traits.text:
Knights may move onto Ruined Wall Terrain tiles during their voluntary movement.
Knights may move onto Tower Terrain tiles from Ruined Wall Terrain tiles or the VP during their voluntary movement.
Knights treat Tower and Ruined Wall Terrain tiles as Indestructible during their involuntary movement.

traits.name: Climbable Appendages
traits.text: Young Devour Dragon starts the Clash with the VP unlocked.

traits.name: Dragonfeast
traits.text: Additional Setup: Add the Your Death Becomes a Dragon's Sacrament Judicium card to the Judicium deck.

traits.name: Groundscraper
traits.text: Ram: The Dragon moves adjacent to the designated Terrain tile. Then, trigger effects based on the current Phase's Trait card.

traits.name: Curse of Endless Hunger
traits.text: End of Monster Round: [Divine Target] Divine Target loses [V] equal to their [P].

traits.name: Inescapable Maw
traits.text: When a Knight is Devoured, place their Portrait card near the Monster Sheet, they cannot be resurrected during that Clash.

vp.name: Broad Back
vp.text:
Climb: Test Might (10+).
Hold on: End of Monster Round: If on the VP, test Tenacity (12+). Fail: Knockdown, Displace.
Young Devour Dragon starts with the VP unlocked.
[Divine Target] Divine Target cannot move to the VP. When you leave the VP, gain the [Divine Target] Divine Target token.
While on the VP, you have +X [Power], where X is the Level of the attacked BP. If you deal a Wound, gain +1 [P].

routine.name: Craving's Call
routine.text:
Each Knight with the Called by the Heavens Condition card dies. All other Knights gain the Called by the Heavens Condition card.
The Dragon moves to the center of the Clash Board, then turns to face the most Knights.

traitCards.name: Flying High
traitCards.text:
The Dragon gains +4 To Hit unless attacked from a Terrain tile, the VP, or during a Lunging Attack (see Tower Terrain tile).
The Dragon gains +2 To Hit when attacked from a Ruined Wall Terrain tile.
The Dragon doesn't destroy Terrain tiles and doesn't cause Crash unless stated otherwise.
You fail all Climb tests.
When the Dragon Rams a Tower, each Knight on it suffers Crash.
—
When you finish resolving the current action, if there are 3+ Wounds on the Wound Stack, remove this card and all AI 1 and BP 1 cards from the Clash, except cards on the Wound Stack. Create new AI and BP decks using AI 2 and BP 2 cards. Then, the Dragon performs AI.

traitCards.name: Floating Low
traitCards.text:
The Dragon has +2 To Hit unless attacked from a Terrain tile, the VP, or during a Lunging Attack (see Tower Terrain tile).
The Dragon causes Crash as normal.
When the Dragon Rams a Tower, that Tower is destroyed.
—
When you finish resolving the current action, if there are 6+ Wounds on the Wound Stack:
Exhibition: You win the Clash.
Full Clash: Remove this card and all AI 2 and BP 2 cards from the Clash, except cards on the Wound Stack. Create new AI and BP decks using AI 3 and BP 3 cards. Then, the Dragon performs AI.

traitCards.name: Grounded
traitCards.text:
The Dragon Crash Devours you (you die). If you survive, Displace to the closest Empty Space.
If a Knight with the Called by the Heavens Condition card would draw a Judicium, they are Devoured instead.
+3 to all Climb tests.
When the Dragon Rams a Tower, that Tower is destroyed and all Knights on it are devoured (die).
—
To leave the VP voluntarily, you must pass a Climb Down test (same difficulty as the Climb test).
